name: Integrator (Aegis Archetype)
body:
To an integrator, being the ultimate weapon means sacrificing your bodily integrity to become something more than flesh. Replacing parts of themselves with artificial components and weapons, integrators push beyond their mortality to become supreme artificial threats.

Mechanical Body (Su)

The integrator’s body is loaded with dozens of augments and enhancements that offer it superhuman capabilities. The integrator gains a +1 natural armor bonus to his AC as a result of his enhancements. At 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter (10th, 15th, and 20th), the natural armor bonus increases by 1.

An integrator can modify his form in a fashion similar to the aegis’s customization. Because the integrator is modifying his own body, he can wear armor as normal.

The integrator can select the following aberrant customizations as well: Disjointed, Improved Natural Armor, Spikes, Poison, Spikes, and Protective Shell. The integrator gains four additional customization points at 1st level, two at 2nd level, and two at 12th level.

This replaces astral suit.

Inorganic (Ex)

The integrator cannot be healed by sources that provide healing only to living creatures (such as cure light wounds or channel energy), but can be healed by effects that repair damage such as make whole and the astral repair class feature. For the purpose of effects based on creature type (such as favored enemy or the bane weapon special ability), the integrator is considered to be both a construct and a creature of his original type.

At 3rd level, the integrator gains a +2 bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects, paralysis, poison, stun effects, death effects, disease effects, and sleep effects.
At 5th level, the integrator becomes immune to disease, poison, and sleep effects.
At 7th level, the integrator becomes immune to fatigue and exhaustion and no longer needs to breathe.
At 9th level, the bonus on saving throws increases to +4.
At 11th level, the integrator becomes immune to paralysis and stunning effects.
At 13th level, the integrator becomes immune to death effects, death from massive damage, necromancy effects, and nonlethal damage. However, he cannot be resurrected by any effect which requires an intact body (such as raise dead, though resurrection and similar effects function normally).
At 15th level, the integrator becomes immune to ability damage and ability drain.

This ability replaces reconfigure.

Systemic Bypass (Su)

At 12th level, the integrator learns to utilize his unusual makeup to escape dire situations. As a free action once per day, an integrator may ignore any of the following effects on him for a number of rounds equal to his Intelligence modifier (minimum 1):

Blinded, confused, cowering, dazed, dazzled, deafened, disabled, dying (though he still takes hit point damage each round), energy drained, fascinated, frightened, helpless, nauseated, panicked, paralyzed, petrified, shaken, sickened, staggered, stunned, or unconscious.

The integrator may use this ability outside his turn and when he could not normally take actions.

At 14th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the integrator may use this ability an additional time per day.

This ability replaces cannibalize suit.

Full Integration (Ex)

At 20th level, the integrator is now a full construct. His type changes to construct, gaining all of the traits of the construct type. Rather than gaining bonus hit points based on size, the integrator gains bonus hit points equal to his character level × his Intelligence modifier. In addition, the effects of mechanical body cannot be suppressed by effects that suppress psionics or technology (such as a null psionics field).

This ability replaces perfect merger.
